title: Review 2 — Describing Your Everyday Life
module: Módulo 2 — Objetos, descrições e ações cotidianas

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Describe a normal weekday” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Review plural, adjectives, possessives and all three regular present classes.
student.english_comparison: English has no adjective agreement; Portuguese does.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “I work and study.”?
Which sentence expresses “My friend lives here.”?
Which sentence expresses “We eat at home.”?
Which sentence expresses “They open the store.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Minha rotina é simples. Eu estudo português de manhã e trabalho à tarde. Minha amiga mora perto da escola. Nós comemos arroz no almoço. Os professores abrem a sala cedo. Meus livros são novos e minha mesa é pequena.
questions: A rotina é simples ou complicada?
A amiga mora perto da escola?
O que você come de manhã?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Build a complete routine using known people, objects and present-tense verbs.

examples.en: I drink water in the morning.

review.compare: Ela come / Elas comem: agreement of subject and verb.

common_mistakes.explanation: Plural appears on noun and adjective.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

items.cue: I drink water in the morning.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.
items: I drink water in the morning.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Eles abrem a loja. Nós ________ em casa.
Os livros são novos. Eles ________ a loja.
Eu bebo água de manhã. Os livros ________ novos.
Eu trabalho e estudo. Eu ________ água de manhã.
items.hint: I drink water in the morning.

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Pedro mora em uma casa grande. Ele trabalha de manhã. Sua irmã estuda inglês e aprende português. Os amigos comem em casa. A mesa é branca e os livros são novos. À noite, eles falam com a professora.
questions: Pedro mora em uma casa grande ou pequena?
A irmã de Pedro estuda inglês?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

questions.question: O que você come de manhã?
questions.english: What do you eat in the morning?

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “I work and study.”? A. Os livros são novos. B. Eles abrem a loja. C. Eu trabalho e estudo.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: C. Eu trabalho e estudo. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.instruction: Eu ________ e estudo. (I work and study.)
B_gap_fill.worked_answer: trabalho → Eu trabalho e estudo. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Nós comemos em casa. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: I work and study. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.instruction: A rotina é simples ou complicada?
E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: A rotina é simples. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Eles abrem a loja.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Os livros são novos. — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Eu bebo água de manhã. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Choose the sentence with the given meaning.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “My friend lives here.”?
Which sentence expresses “We eat at home.”?
Which sentence expresses “They open the store.”?
Which sentence expresses “The books are new.”?
Which sentence expresses “I drink water in the morning.”?

items.hint: I drink water in the morning.

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Nós somos alunos e trabalhamos durante o dia. Meu irmão mora com os amigos. Ele estuda à noite. Nós bebemos café de manhã. As professoras são simpáticas. Os livros delas são novos. Depois do trabalho, nós aprendemos palavras em português.
questions: O irmão mora com a família ou com os amigos?
O irmão estuda de manhã ou à noite?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 4–6 sentences on the topic “Describe a normal weekday”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Onde você mora? / O que você come de manhã? / Você estuda e trabalha? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Practice word stress in trabalham and aprendemos.

mini_reading.translation: My routine is simple. I study Portuguese in the morning and work in the afternoon. My friend lives near school. We eat rice for lunch. The teachers open the classroom early. My books are new and my table is small.

answers.question: A rotina é simples ou complicada?
A amiga mora perto da escola?
answers.answer: Sim, a amiga mora perto da escola.

oral_substitution_drill.cue: I drink water in the morning.

fill_in.full_sentence: Eles abrem a loja. Nós comemos em casa.
Os livros são novos. Eles abrem a loja.
Eu bebo água de manhã. Os livros são novos.
Eu trabalho e estudo. Eu bebo água de manhã.

reading_aloud.translation: Pedro lives in a big house. He works in the morning. His sister studies English and learns Portuguese. The friends eat at home. The table is white and the books are new. At night, they talk with the teacher.

answers.question: Pedro mora em uma casa grande ou pequena?
answers.answer: Pedro mora em uma casa grande.

answers.question: A irmã de Pedro estuda inglês?
answers.answer: Sim, ela estuda inglês e aprende português.

speaking_practice.question: Onde você mora?
speaking_practice.watch_for: As casa são bonita. → As casas são bonitas. (Plural appears on noun and adjective.) Nós estuda português. → Nós estudamos português. (Nós takes -amos.)

speaking_practice.question: O que você come de manhã?
speaking_practice.watch_for: As casa são bonita. → As casas são bonitas. (Plural appears on noun and adjective.) Nós estuda português. → Nós estudamos português. (Nós takes -amos.)

speaking_practice.question: Você estuda e trabalha?
speaking_practice.watch_for: As casa são bonita. → As casas são bonitas. (Plural appears on noun and adjective.) Nós estuda português. → Nós estudamos português. (Nós takes -amos.)

D_portuguese_to_english: I drink water in the morning.

E_reading.translation: We are students and we work during the day. My brother lives with friends. He studies at night. We drink coffee in the morning. The teachers are friendly. Their books are new. After work, we learn words in Portuguese.

answers.question: O irmão mora com a família ou com os amigos?
answers.answer: O irmão mora com os amigos.

answers.question: O irmão estuda de manhã ou à noite?
Eles bebem café de manhã?
answers.answer: Sim, eles bebem café de manhã.

F_written_production.model_text: Nós somos alunos e trabalhamos durante o dia. Meu irmão mora com os amigos. Ele estuda à noite. Nós bebemos café de manhã. As professoras são simpáticas. Os livros delas são novos. Depois do trabalho, nós aprendemos palavras em português.
F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
